dabbha:
1dabbha
dabba1 m. [S. darbha], darbha grass, kuśa grass; SAF: Demostachys bipinnata Stapf; a bunch of kuśa grass (used in sacrifices); Abh 602 (kuso barihisaṃ ~o); 1079 (kuso ~e); D I 141,.29 (tasmiṃ … yaññe … na ~ā lūyiṃsu barihisatthāya, Be, Ee so; Ce dabbā; Se na dabbā lāyiṃsu parihiṃsatthāya; Sv 300,.23 : yāni ca °-tiṇāni … yaññasālaṃ parikkhipanti bhūmiyaṃ vā santharanti, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce dabbatiṇāni); M I 344,.9 (ettakā ~ā lūyantu barihisatthāyā ti, Be, Ee so; Ce dabbā; Se dabbā luyantu parisanthāyā ti) = A II 207,.32 (Be, Ee so; Ce, Se dabbā); — see also dabba2.

2dabba
dabbha2 m. (and n.) [cf S. darbha, None G.M. Meulenbeld, 1974, pp. 561–62], a kind of grass; Th 27 (~aṃ kusaṃ poṭakilaṃ usīraṃ muñjapabbajaṃ urasā panudahissāmi; Th-a I 90,.15 : ~an ti °-tiṇaṃ āha yaṃ saddulo ti pi vuccati) = Ap 505,.23 (Ce so; Be kāsaṃ; Ee dabbhaṃ; Se sabbaṃ); Nidd-a I 413,.24 (āthabbaṇikā kira sattāhaṃ aloṇakaṃ bhuñjitvā ~e attharitvā paṭhaviyaṃ sayamānā tapaṃ caritvā) = As 92,.8 (Be, Se so; Ce, Ee dabbhe); Ap-a 505,.6 (~e patitattā Dabbo Mallaputto ti pākaṭo ahosi); Sadd 406,.4 foll. (dubbā ti °-tiṇaṃ … dubbā ti itthiliṅgaṃ ~an ti napuṃsakaliṅgan ti daṭṭhabbaṃ); —      °-gahana,   n. [dabba + gahana2], a thicket of darbha grass; an impenetrable clump of darbha grass; Ja V 46,.17 (~aṃ kāsagahanaṃ tiṇagahanaṃ); —       °-chadana,   n., a roof of darbha grass; Ap-a 465,.14 (~aṃ katvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee taṃ daṇḍaṃ chadanaṃ katvā; ad Ap 198,.6 : Be, Ce tiṇena chadanaṃ katvā; Ee taṃ tiṇaṃ; Se tidaṇḍe); —       °-tiṇa,   n., darbha grass; Ja I 177,.23 (takkaṃ ca ~āni ca āharāpethā ti); V 23,.9 (~esu nisīditvā); Mp III 319,.15 (tiriyā nāma tiṇajātī ti ~aṃ vuccati); Sadd 406,.5 (~aṃ yaṃ tiriyā nāma tiṇajātī ti āgataṃ); —       °-tiṇaka,   n., darbha grass; Vism 353,.29 (suññagāmaṭṭhāne jātesu ~esu, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce °-tiṇesu; = Vibh-a 57,.23 : eds °-tiṇesu); —       °-tthambha,   m. [dabba + thambha1], a clump of darbha grass; Th-a I 43,.14 (ekasmiṃ ~e nipati) = Mp I 274,.11; — see also dabbha1, dubbā.
daṭṭhā:
daṭṭha(r)
m. [S. draṣṭṛ], one who sees; A II 25,.14 (tathāgato daṭṭhā daṭṭhabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na maññati … daṭṭhāraṃ na maññati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se diṭṭhānaṃ; Mp III 40,.1 : passitāraṃ … na maññatī ti).
ekacciya:
1ekacciya
ekaccika mfn. [cf S. lex. ekatīya?], single, of a single thickness; Vin I 289,.1 foll. (anujānāmi bhikkhave ticīvaraṃ diguṇaṃ saṅghātiṃ ~aṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ ~aṃ antaravāsakan ti; Sp 1128,.13 foll. : ~an ti ekapaṭṭaṃ … dviguṇaṃ saṅghātiṃ anujānāti ekaccike itare); 290,.3 (samantato dupaṭṭaṃ bhavissati majjhe ~an ti); Ja V 216,17´ (ekaccavasanā ti ekaccikavasanā ekapaṭṭa-nivatthā ti attho, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ekavatthanivatthā ti attho).

2ekacciya
mfn. [cf ekacca], a certain, a certain sort of; some; S I 86,13* (itthī pi hi ~ā seyyā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ekaccī yā seyyo; Spk I 155,.15 : dandhapaññasmā eḷamūgaputtato ekaccā itthī yeva seyyā); 199,20* (~ā pana Vajja-bhūmiyā magā viya asaṅgacārino aniketā viharanti bhikkhavo, eds so; read ekatiyā mc?); Ja I 326,7* foll. (saccaṃ kir’ evaṃ āhaṃsu narā ~ā idha kaṭṭhaṃ viplāvitaṃ seyyo na tv ev’ ~o naro; 326,10´ foll. : narā ~ā idhā ti idh’ ekacce paṇḍitapurisā … ekacco pana mittadūbhī akataññū pāpapuriso) = IV 259,18* foll. quoted Sadd 285,29*; Pj I 184,.11 (tato ~ānaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ekaccānaṃ); II 156,.16 (atha vā ~ena matena); — see also ekaceyya, ekacca, ekatiya.
nimmināti:
nimināti
nimmināti1 pr. 3 sg. [cf S. ni√me, nimayate], barters, exchanges for (instr.); Ja III 63,10* (mayā pi Sāmā ~eyya aññaṃ; 63,15´ foll. : sā Sāmā mayā pi aññaṃ sāmikaṃ parivattetvā gaṇheyya) ≠ III 222,1*; V 343,13* (etena ~ā tuvaṃ; 343,19´ : parivattehi tvaṃ); — fut. 3 sg. nimissati, Ja V 453,21* (devatāhi nirayaṃ nimissati; 455,15´ foll. : devalokena parivattetvā nirayaṃ gaṇhissati, so read? Ce devaloke; Be parivattitvā; Ee sadevalokena; Se devalokato nivattitvā); 1 sg. nimissaṃ, Th 32 (tappamānena nibbutiṃ nimissaṃ, so read? Be nimisaṃ; Ce, Ee nimmissaṃ; Se nirāmisaṃ; Th-a I 98,.13 : nimissan ti parivatteyyaṃ cetāpeyyaṃ, Ee so; Be nimisan ti; Ce nimmissan ti; Se nimiyan ti); Ja V 27,22* (pāṇena te pāṇam ahaṃ nimissaṃ); — aor. 3 sg. nimini (and nimisi?), Ja III 63,9* (Ee, Se so; Be, Ce nimīni, mc) ≠ 221,26* (Be nimīni; Ce nimīsi; Ee niminni; Se nimisi); 1 sg. nimminiṃ [or of nimmināti2], Cp 2:6:11 (nimminiṃ mama attanā; Cp-a 150,.27 : mama attano attabhāvena taṃ parivaṭṭesiṃ); 1 pl. nimimhase, nimimha, Ja II 369,17* (vaṇṇaṃ añjanavaṇṇena Kāliṅgasmiṃ nimimhase, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se vinimhase; 369,23´ foll. : vinimayavasena gaṇhimha paribhogavasena vā udare pakkhipimhā ti attho … iminā attano santakena viya añjanavaṇṇena [nāgena] … bahudhanadhaññaṃ nimimhase parivattayimha … aparo nayo … Kaliṅgassa santike iminā añjanavaṇṇena tava vaṇṇaṃ nimimhase nimimha tulayimha, Be so; Se vinimhase; Ce, Ee iminā añjanavaṇṇaṃ nāgaṃ dhaññena nimimhase …); — absol. (a) niminitvā, Mil 279,.31 (api ca puttadāraṃ yācanena niminitvā attānaṃ dātabban ti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se yācante; Se omits ~itvā); — (b) nimminitvāna [or of nimmināti2], Cp 2:9:7 (nimminitvāna attānaṃ, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce nissajjitvāna; cf Cp-a 171,.18 : pitaraṃ nivattetvā putto āgato bhavissati).

2nimmināti
pr. 3 sg. [S. nir√mā, BHS nirminoti, nirminati], 1. produces, forms, creates (by magic or supernatural power); Th 1183 (attabhāvaṃ khaṇena ~e; Th-a III 171,.27 : ~eyya ~ituṃ samattho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se nimmituṃ); Sp 579,.16 (bahū attabhāve ~āti); 1335,.32 foll. (buddhassa bhagavato attabhāvasadisaṃ attabhāvaṃ ~āhī ti, na sakkā bhante tādisaṃ rūpaṃ ~ituṃ, api ca kho pana taṃ sarikkhakaṃ paṭirūpakaṃ ~issāmī ti); Sv 1001,.6 (yathārucitaṃ kāmabhogaṃ ~anti); — part.pr. nimminanta, mfn., Ud-a 344,.32; — aor. 3 sg. (a) nimmini, Ja I 232,.16 (Māro … aṅgārakāsuṃ ~i); Dhp-a IV 57,.20 (abhirūpaṃ itthiṃ ~i); (b) nimmāyi, Mhv 5:92; — 2. [or nimmināti1] measures against, matches; — aor. 1 sg. nimminiṃ, Cp 2:6:11 (~iṃ mama attanā; Cp-a 150,.27 : mama attano attabhāvena taṃ parivaṭṭesiṃ); — absol. (a) nimmāya [S. nirmāya], Vv 16:3 (nimmāya nimmāya ramanti devatā); (b) nimminitvā, D III 218,.14 (te ~itvā ~itvā kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti seyyathā pi devā nimmānaratī, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nimmetvā nimmetvā, prob. wr; Sv 1001,.1 : yādisaṃ yādisaṃ attano rūpaṃ icchanti tādisaṃ tādisaṃ ~itvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nimmitvā, prob. wr); Ja VI 201,13´ (brahmā kira brāhmaṇādayo cattāro vaṇṇe ~itvā); Ap 2,.19 (atīte sabbabuddhe … pakativaṇṇarūpena ~itvā); Bv 21:11 (hatthiyānaṃ ~itvā; Bv-a 246,.21 : ~itvā ti tassa hatthino pamāṇena tulayitva); Vism 404,.32 (paṭhavīkasiṇavasena ākāse maggaṃ ~itvā); (c) nimminitvāna, Th 563 (sahassakkhattum attānaṃ ~itvāna); Ap 352,.19 (pīṭhaṃ ~itvāna); Cp 2:9:7 (~itvāna attānaṃ, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce nissajjitvāna; or to nimmināti1; cf Cp-a 171,.18 : pitaraṃ nivattetvā putto āgato bhavissati); —     pp (a) nimmita,   mfn., m.n. and ~ā, m.pl. [S., BHS nirmita], 1. (mfn. and m.n.) formed, produced, created; (a form) created (by magic or supernatural power); a magical creation; Vin I 32,.3 (nissaṃsayaṃ kho mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvo yathā h’ imā mandāmukhiyo ~ā ti); D I 18,.9 (mayā ime sattā ~ā); M II 222,.9 (addhā bhikkhave nigaṇṭhā pāpakena issarena ~ā); Vv 63:29 (sīsaṃ c’ idaṃ veḷuriyassa ~aṃ; Vv-a 269,.6 : veḷuriyamaṇimayan ti attho); Ja IV 453,.26 (Vissakammena ~āya paṇṇasālāya); VI 275,20* (nāgarāje supaṇṇe ca maṇimhi passa ~aṃ; 275,23´ : ~an ti idaṃ evarūpaṃ accherakaṃ maṇimhi ~aṃ passa); Nidd I 340,.16 (so ~o buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchati; Nidd-a I 373,.4 : so bhagavatā ~o buddho); Paṭis I 126,.5 (bhagavā caṅkamati ~o tiṭṭhati vā nisīdati vā …; Paṭis-a 406,.7 : ~o ti iddhiyā māpita-buddharūpaṃ); Ap 111,.30 (thūpaṃ … sammukhā viya sambuddhaṃ ~aṃ abhivandi ’haṃ; Ap-a 385,.24 : ~aṃ uppāditaṃ kāritaṃ cetiyaṃ); Vism 389,.16 (sabbe ~ā antaradhāyiṃsu); Sv 90,.32 (ayaṃ loko kena ~o); Bv-a 280,.2 (bodhisatto uyyānaṃ gacchanto tāhi yeva devatāhi ~aṃ vyādhitaṃ ca purisaṃ disvā); Mhv 5:93; — animmita, mfn., uncreated; not made; D I 56,.27 (ime satta kāyā … animmitā animmātā …; Sv 167,.10 : animmitā ti iddhiyā pi na nimmitā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee iddhiyā pi animmitā) = M I 517,.19 = S III 211,.13; Ja VI 207,20* (kimatthaṃ animmito nimmitaṃ vandit’ assa); — sunimmita, mfn., well made; Vv 35:1 (vyamhaṃ sunimmitaṃ); Ja VI 173,27* (pokkharaññā sunimmitā); Ap 215,.11 (tena kammenayaṃ mayhaṃ attabhāvo sunimmito); — 2. ~aṃ, adv., in a measured or matched way;? Vv-a 36,.12 (mitan ti nimmitaṃ, nikkhepa-padavītikkaman ti attho … vaggu cāru padanikkhepaṃ katvā gacchatī ti, Ee so; Be, Se nikkhepapadaṃ vītikkaman ti; Ce nimitaṃ, padanikkhepapada-; ad Vv 5:3: mitaṃ gacchati vāraṇo); — 3. (m.pl.) the nimmānarati gods; Ja VI 279,9* (yāme ca tusite cāpi ~e); Ap 598,.25 (tusitā ~ā devā); Bv 1:6 (yāmā ca devā tusitā ca ~ā); — pp (b) nimmāta1, mfn. [cf S. māta], created; — neg. animmāta, mfn., uncreated, not made; D I 56,.27 (ime satta kāyā … animmitā animmātā …; Sv 167,.10 : animmātā ti animmāpitā) = M I 517,.20 = S III 211,.13; — fpp (a) nimminitabba, mfn., Spk II 341,.22 (animmitabbā ti pi pāṭho, na nimminitabbā ti attho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se na nimmitabbā ti); Paṭis-a 665,.18; (b) neg. animmitabba, mfn., Ps III 228,.14 (animmātā ti animmāpitā, keci animmitabbā ti padaṃ vadanti, taṃ n’ eva pāḷiyaṃ na aṭṭhakathāyaṃ sandissati) ≠ Spk II 341,.22; (c) neg. animmātabba, mfn., Sv 167,.11 (animmātā ti animmāpitā, keci animmātabbā ti padaṃ vadanti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se animmāpetabbā ti) ≠ Ps III 228,.14 ≠ Spk II 341,.22 (animmitabbā ti pi pāṭho); — caus. neg. pp animmāpita, mfn., Sv 167,.11 = Ps III 228,.14 = Spk II 341,.21; — see also nimmāpanaka.
paccāhata:
1paccāhata
mfn. [pp of paṭi + ā2 + hanati; paṭi + āhata1], smitten, angered (in return); Nidd I 62,.9 (viruddhamanā paṭiviruddhamanā āhatamanā °-manā; Nidd-a I 190,.15 : paṭighena āhataṃ cittaṃ etesan ti āhatamanā, °-manā ti upasaggavasen’ eva); 408,.21 (viruddhā paṭiviruddhā āhatā ~ā āghātitā paccāghātitā; Nidd-a I 427,.8 : āhatā ti kodhena āhatā pahatā, ~ā ti paṭimallā hutvā āhatā).
pavedheti:
pavedhati
pavedheti1 pavedhayati pr. 3 sg. [cf S. pravyathate], is agitated, trembles; is distressed; Vin II 150,.6 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ucce mañcapaṭipādake dhārenti saha mañcapaṭipādakehi ~enti); S IV 206,24* (vedanā dukkhā … yāhi phuṭṭho ~ati); Sn 899 (~atī kamma virādhayitvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sa vedhati; Nidd I 312,.9 : vedhati ~ati sampavedhati); 928 (nindāya nappavedheyya); Th 754 (tena viddho ~āmi pattaṃ va māluteritaṃ); Ja VI 87,4* (hato Sāmo ti sutvāna hadayaṃ me ~ati); Nidd I 250,.13 (na ejati na calati na vedhati nappavedhati; Nidd-a I 350,.17 : nappavedhatī ti na kampati); Paṭis II 102,22* (passaddhiyā sukhe c’ eva yehi cittaṃ ~ati); Ap 68,.4 (dukkhito vimano hoti pajjhāyanto ~ati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee padhāvati); Mil 116,.7 (mahāpaṭhavī calati kampati ~ati); Vism 180,.16 (aṅgapaccaṅgāni vā ~enti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~anti); Spk II 299,.10 (vaccho … khīraṃ alabhanto milāyati kampati ~ati); III 223,.22 (biḷāramukhe pakkhantakukkuṭo viya ~ati); Dhp-a II 249,.16 (amhe dūrato disvā sahassamattā purisā ~anti); — part.pr. (a) pavedha(t), mfn., Paṭis-a 28,10* (taṃ muñciya gotrabhunā aladdha-āsevanena tu pavedhaṃ); (b) pavedhanta, pavedhenta, mf (~antī, ~entī) n., Vin IV 175,.14 (sā bhikkhunī … ~antī gacchati, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce ~entī; Sp 886,.6 : ~entī ti kampamānā, eds so); Ja VI 586,11* (Maddī ca puttake disvā … vāruṇī va ~entī; 586,17´ : yakkhāviṭṭhā ikkhaṇikā viya ~amānā); Dhp-a III 36,.12 (~ento saṃviggamānaso); Thī-a 195,.18 (addasa aññataraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ … allavatthaṃ allakesaṃ ~antaṃ dantavīṇaṃ vādayamānaṃ); (c) pavedhamāna, mfn., D II 22,.2 (addasā … purisaṃ jiṇṇaṃ … daṇḍaparāyanaṃ ~amānaṃ gacchantaṃ); Ja V 16,7*; Nidd I 50,.14; Ap 548,.18; Bv 2:168 (~amānā sā tattha mucchitā seti bhūmiyā); Cp 1:8:6; — aor. 3 sg. pavedhi, Ja III 398,.7 (rukkhadevatā … bhītatasitā ~i); 2 sg. pavedhayi, Cp 1:8:13 (ehi Sīvaka uṭṭhehi mā dandhayi mā ~ayi; Cp-a 68,.34 : mā vedhayi sarīrakampaṃ mā āpajji); —    pp (a) pavedhita, mfn. and n. [or to caus.; cf pavyadhita (sv pavyathayati) and S. pravyathita], 1. (mfn.) agitated; shaking, shaken; S I 148,7* (rūpe raṇaṃ disvā sadā ~aṃ; Spk I 214,.23 : sītādīhi ca niccaṃ ~aṃ calitaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ rūpaṃ disvā); Ja III 345,5* (etena dukkhena ~o ’smi; 345,12´ : ghaṭṭito kampito); Ap 575,.9 (sā ~-sabbaṅgī); — 2. (n.) agitation; shaking; Sn 902 (patthayamānassa hi jappitāni ~aṃ cāpi pakappitesu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee saṃvedhitaṃ; Pj II 559,.8 : taṇhādiṭṭhīhi c’ assa pakappitesu vatthūsu ~aṃ pi hotī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee saṃvedhitaṃ; = Nidd-a I 367,.28 : Be, Ce, Se so; Ee saṃvedhitaṃ); —     neg. pp (b) apaviddha, mfn., not trembling; Ja V 52,.14 (so [hatthī] pana ubbedhato aṭṭhāsītihattho pabbato viya ~o, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se rajatapabbato viya ṭhito); — fpp pavedhitabba, (mf)n., Nidd-a I 395,.11 (araññe vasatā bheravaṃ disvā vā sutvā vā na ppavedhitabban ti dasseti); —      caus. pr. 3 sg.    pavedheti, shakes; agitates; Vin I 185,7* (iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca na ~enti tādino ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ) = Th 644 (Th-a II 271,.32 : cittaṃ … na cālenti); — absol. pavedhetvā, Mp III 392,.24 (naṃ … na sampavedheyyā ti vedhetvā ~etvā pātetuṃ na sakkuṇeyya); — see also pavyathayati.
paṭibāhetvā:
2paṭibāhitvā
paṭibāhetvā2, ind. [?], smoothing; rubbing; Vin II 151,.13 (anujānāmi bhikkhave thusapiṇḍaṃ datvā pāṇikāya ~itvā setavaṇṇaṃ nipātetun ti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ~etvā; Sp-ṭ [Be] III 395,.17 : ~etvā ti maṭṭhaṃ katvā; Vmv [Be] II 238,.23 : ~etvā ti ghaṃsitvā).
puthubhūta:
1puthu
putha(k) adv. [S. pṛthak], apart; separately, differently; severally; individually; one by one; Abh 1137; S I 75,27* (evaṃ piyo ~u attā paresaṃ) = Ud 47,23* (Ud-a 275,.19 : ~u visuṃ visuṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ attā piyo); Sn 314 (~u vibhinnā khattiyā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~ū; or to puthu2; cf Pj II 324,.25 : khattiyā pi bahū aññamanñaṃ bhinnā); Thī 344 (aññamaññena vyāruddhā ~u kubbanti medhagaṃ; or to puthu2; cf Thī-a 225,.32 : ~ū sattā, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce ~u); Ja IV 346,25* (imassudaṃ yanti disodisaṃ pure bhayadditā lenagavesino ~u; 347,6´ : ~ū ti visuṃ visuṃ); VI 240,35* (kammassakā ye ~u sabbasattā); Pj II 554,.21 (~u ~u vadanti ekaṃ na vadanti); Sadd 703,.21 (ariyehi puthag evāyaṃ jano); 900,.2 (~u visuṃ icc ete asaṅghāṭe); —      °-g-attatā, f. [cf S. lex. pṛthagātmatā], discrimination; Abh 430 (viveko ~ā); —       putha-kamma, n., separating out; setting apart; Sadd 531,.5 (bhāja ~ani, ~aṃ puthakkaraṇaṃ, visuṃkiriyā ti attho); —       putha-kkaraṇa, n. [S. pṛthakkaraṇa], separating out; setting apart; Sadd 531,.5; 724,.26 (tehi eva jāti-ādīhi samudāyato ekassa ~aṃ); —       putha-kkāra, m., separating; Dhātum 523; 777 (bhaja ~e); —       °-jja, mfn., severally, individually, produced;? Sn 897 (yā kāc’ imā sammutiyo ~ā; cf Nidd I 308,.19 foll.: ~ā ti puthujjanehi janitā vā … puthunānājanehi janitā vā; Pj II 558,.3; puthujjanasambhavā); —       °-jjana, m.f., see sv; —       °-bhūta1, mfn., separated, apart from; Pj II 547,.5 (kāmehi ritto ti … sabbakāmehi ~o) = Nidd-a I 308,.13; Sadd 626,.27 (putha icc etassa anto saro vyañjane pare ukāro hoti: puthujjano ~aṃ).
